name: 20186 · Warrenton, VA
findings: ZIP 20186 (Warrenton) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20186 (Warrenton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20186 (Warrenton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
